text: The purpose of this report is to respond to City Council's request for information about the legal implications of denying all road occupancy permits for development sites and forcing developers to build onsite, from its meeting on May 14 and 15, 2019. More time is needed to complete a report on the topic raised by Council.

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council refer consideration of the matters originally requested with respect to the Legal Implications of Denying all Road Occupancy Permits for Development Sites to the November 7, 2019 meeting of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee.
